events.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch
must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

events.text: Could you make this pic of me into a talking video where I say something about our sale? I always overthink these little sale messages, so I’d really appreciate having you handle the wording. You can write the line yourself, and somewhere in all of that I need it to be an 8-second square video with a friendly male English voice. Keep the message upbeat and mention our sale generally, without inventing any discounts, dates or products. I’m just hoping it feels welcoming rather than like I’m making a big fuss about it. Please don’t include any captions.

events.text:
I need an 8-second square talking-photo video with a friendly male English voice and no captions, and I'm writing the script myself. The talking-photo tool needs audio, and I don't have a direct text-to-speech option, so I'm looking at create_spoken_ad_video instead. It takes the image and script, runs on ltx-2.5 under the free plan, and allows an 8-second end time. The source image is 1024x1024, so the output should also come out square. Before I call anything, I want to run plan_request first.

The 25-word script runs about 8 to 9 seconds, so I'm cutting it to around 20 words to fit the 8-second limit. The shorter version keeps the sale greeting and the invitation to look around. I still need to check whether plan_request applies to create_spoken_ad_video, since that tool isn't in its listed enum, and I'll note that the voice has to come from the image rather than from an explicit setting.

events.text: I've hit an insufficient credits error, so I can't go ahead with this. Retrying through other methods would cost credits too, and a talking photo needs audio regardless, so I'll explain that to the user and lay out the options.

I couldn't make the video. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it turned the request down and nothing was created.

Here's the line I wrote. It's about 8 seconds when spoken, upbeat without being pushy, and it doesn't mention any discounts, dates or products:

> "Hi there! Our sale is on now. Come on in, take a look around, and find something you love. See you soon!"

Once you've added credits or upgraded your plan, I can make it in one go with these settings:
- **Your photo** as the speaker. It's already square, so the video will be square too.
- **8 seconds** long, using the free-plan video settings.
- **The line above**, spoken in English.
- **No captions.** This tool doesn't add any text on screen.

There's no setting to choose the voice. It's picked from the photo, so it should come out male, but I can't guarantee it will sound friendly.

If you'd like different wording, tell me and I'll change it before we try again.
